kind_note: Two kind = "aurus-score" phases run through campaign.py over the AuRUS arm of 2026-09-22-aurus-rerun. The anytime pass reads the raw tree experiments/aurus-rerun-out and writes one row per solution with its compare verdict against the ideals and its discovery time. The well-separation pass reads the adapted tree experiments/results-aurus-rerun and writes one row per candidate file. No search ran here.
question: Per-solution ideal verdicts and discovery times for the un-censored AuRUS arm, and a well-separation verdict for each of its solutions, so that the paper's AuRUS found and ideal flags can be screened as the PEREDUR side's are.
endpoint: None pre-registered. These rows feed the paper's aurus_full.csv equivalent and its well-separation screen, through ~/projects/writing/counter-paper/data/rerun-2026-09-uncensored.
decision_rule_firing: None registered and none taken. 2026-09-22-aurus-rerun's decision reads the reference built from the anytime rows; see that archive.

profile_commit.parent_history: Four commits on top of 3cd6efb (2026-09-22-aurus-rerun-curves): 5da7d00 keeps compare's relation map beside each curve, b81df3e adds the aurus-score phase kind and its host runner, a2da7bb dates AuRUS solutions from the fork's solution-times.csv, and 5891b06 declares this campaign. None touches src/, include/ or CMakeLists.txt (git diff --stat 3cd6efb 5891b06).

compare.note: Source-identical to 3cd6efb's compare and to 0cfd14a's, no C++ having changed between them.

scoring_binaries.source: the `binaries` block of aurus-score-manifest-avlab12.json and aurus-score-manifest-av3.json in each phase's output directory

hosts.note: Each host scored only the repeats it ran. av3's clock runs fast with network time off.

anytime_pass.warnings: warnings.log holds 1170 lines a host, progress and run headers, with no warning or error line.
anytime_pass.scorer_vintage: score_aurus_anytime.py at 5891b06 (blob 68c3329, last changed a2da7bb) reads the fork's solution-times.csv and falls back to run.log. The copy at 3cd6efb on campaign/aurus-rerun-curves (blob 187d64d) predates the fork and has no solution-times reader; it ran nothing.

wellsep_pass.warnings: warnings.log holds 354 run headers a host and no warning or error line.

anytime-aurus-uncensored.csv.dated_by_note: The 72 run-log rows are the 72 no-solutions units, which carry no solution to date. Every scorable row is dated from solution-times.csv.
anytime-aurus-uncensored.csv.timeout_note: All 18,574 timeout verdicts are humanoid-742's, out of its 18,988 solutions: compare's own per-candidate timeout verdict, inside units that finished in at most 798 s, not the 3000 s subprocess timeout.

wellsep-aurus-uncensored.csv.blank_columns: sweep, arm, scheme, spec and seed are blank on all 296,300 rows: check_well_separated.py's parse_run_id did not populate them on this tree, contrary to campaign.toml's expectation. Recover spec, seed and index from `path` with aurus_(.+)_seed(\d+)/.*?/spec(\d+)\.tlsf$, which matches every row.

rows.join: Outside humanoid-741 the well-separation rows (290,935) equal the anytime pass's ok rows (290,935). The paper's PROVENANCE.txt records the (spec, repeat, index) join as exact with no orphan on either side.
rows.collected_with: campaign.py collect --curves <name> for each phase, on 2026-09-24 (joined-file mtimes 13:49), into <name>/<host>/ and <name>.csv.

consumer_rules: Parse spec and seed for well-separation rows off `path`; the columns are blank.
Drop humanoid-741's 5,365 well-separation verdicts before joining: the anytime pass grades none of its solutions, having no ideals, so they would join to nothing.
The 30 no-ideals-dir and 72 no-solutions anytime rows are one per unit with blank verdict, index and time.

results.screened: 116,325 of 291,007 AuRUS solutions are not well-separated (40.0%), and 987 of the 8,029 ideal hits are among them.
results.decision: These rows feed the reference behind 2026-09-22-aurus-rerun's decision: Outcome 3, parity at p = 0.7214.

caveats: Post-hoc throughout. No decision rule is registered here.

On humanoid-742 compare returned `timeout` for 18,574 of 18,988 solutions, so that family's AuRUS ideal count rests on 414 decided verdicts and is a lower bound. AuRUS still reads 0.833 there in the registered table.

The anytime pass's discovery times are the fork's own clock, which starts after JVM start-up and spec parsing. The paper adds a measured per-run offset of 0.127 s to 1.457 s (aurus-offsets.csv); the rows here carry no offset.

vendored_scripts.note: Verbatim copies of scripts/ at 5891b06, the commit the hosts ran, extracted with git show and checked with git hash-object. aurus_score_campaign.py ran each phase on the host and imports run_experiments.py; score_aurus_anytime.py and check_well_separated.py scored each unit; campaign.py staged and drove the phases and imports merge_experiments.py. gen_configs.py is vendored because the close procedure requires it; no config was generated.

config_vintage: Not applicable. A score pass reads no config.
